widget.name: Status Timeline Chart
widget.description: Counts items per status per period from a list of status changes and shows them as columns, an area or lines.

property.caption: Status changes
property.description: One object per status change. Use XPath to keep only status changes and limit the time span: all matches are loaded.

property.caption: Change date
property.description: When the change happened (may be over an association). Decides the period of the change.

property.caption: New status
property.description: The status the item moved INTO: its name or its object id (ids become names via the Statuses list).

property.caption: Item ID
property.description: Something unique per item, e.g. its number. Needed for "Snapshot at period end".

property.caption: Statuses
property.description: All statuses in stacking order (first = bottom). Maps ids to names, sets the order, shows statuses with 0 items.

property.caption: Status name
property.description: The display name of a status. Should match "New status" when that holds names.

property.caption: Status color
property.description: Optional CSS color on the status object, e.g. #E74C3C. Wins over "Status colors".

property.caption: What to count
property.description: Snapshot: items in each status at the END of each period. Changes: moves INTO each status during each period.

property.caption: Period
property.description: How much time one column or point covers.

property.caption: Periods to show
property.description: How many periods back from the last one (Month + 12 = last 12 months). 0 = everything.

property.caption: Last period
property.description: Today: ends with the current period. Last change: ends with the period of the newest change.

property.caption: Week starts on
property.description: Only used when Period = Week.

property.caption: Chart style
property.description: Stacked columns: statuses on top of each other. Columns: side by side. Users can change it (User options tab).

property.caption: Title
property.description: Optional title shown above the chart.

property.caption: Height (px)
property.description: Height of the chart area in pixels. The width follows the container.

property.caption: Show totals
property.description: Writes each period's total above it. Lines: adds a dashed "Total" line.

property.caption: Show grid lines
property.description: Light horizontal lines behind the chart to help read values.

property.caption: Status colors
property.description: Fixed colors per status, separated by ";", e.g. Open=#E74C3C; Done=#27AE60. Others use the palette.

property.caption: Hide statuses
property.description: Statuses to leave out, separated by ";", e.g. Done; Cancelled. (empty) = changes without a status.

property.caption: Status order
property.description: Stacking order without a Statuses list, separated by ";" (first = bottom). Others follow alphabetically.

property.caption: X axis title
property.description: Optional text under the time axis, e.g. "Month".

property.caption: Y axis title
property.description: Optional text next to the count axis, e.g. "Items".

property.caption: Date label format
property.description: Empty = automatic. Tokens: d dd MMM MMMM MM yy yyyy W (week) Q (quarter); 'text' in quotes is kept.

property.caption: Show legend
property.description: Shows the color of each status. Clicking a status in the legend hides or shows it.

property.caption: Legend position
property.description: Where the legend is placed around the chart.

property.caption: Show style switcher
property.description: Buttons above the chart to switch the chart style.

property.caption: Show options button
property.description: An Options button that opens a panel to change counting, period, titles and legend. Settings here are the defaults.

property.caption: Stacked columns
property.description: Users may pick "Stacked columns". The Chart style setting is always allowed.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Users may pick "Columns" (side by side).

property.caption: Stacked area
property.description: Users may pick "Stacked area".

property.caption: Lines
property.description: Users may pick "Lines".

property.caption: Remember user choices
property.description: Keeps what users picked, also after a reload. Off: every visit starts with the settings above.

property.caption: Save choices in
property.description: Browser: per user and browser, no setup. Database: follows the user to every device (needs a data view).

property.caption: Choices attribute
property.description: Unlimited String on the data view's object (e.g. the user's preferences). Holds JSON for all widgets by name.

property.caption: On choices changed
property.description: Runs after the attribute was updated, e.g. a nanoflow that commits the object.
